newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ C 239 of August 6, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Corrigendum to summary of Community decisions on marketing authorizations in respect of medicinal products from 15 June 1997 to 15 July 1997 (Official Journal of the European Communities No C 226 of 25 July 1997)

Corrigendum to Council Decision of 9 June 1997 appointing members and alternate members of the Advisory Committee on Freedom of Movement for Workers (Official Journal of the European Communities No C 194 of 25 June 1997)
Authorization for State aid pursuant to Articles 92 and 93 of the EC Treaty Cases where the Commission raises no objections

Standing invitation to tender pursuant to Commission Regulation (EEC) No 570/88 of 16 February 1988 on the sale of butter at reduced prices and the granting of aid for butter and concentrated butter for use in the manufacture of pastry products, ice-cream and other foodstuffs
Communication of Decisions under sundry tendering procedures in agriculture (milk and milk products)
